data.current_summary: Resolve a coordinate to the boundaries that contain it
data.current_description:
Point-in-polygon lookup. Returns the administrative boundaries containing the point
and any matches from the account's own boundary sets.

Add `street` to `base` for the nearest street: three answers, within 5 m, within
20 m and unlimited, each a house number and street, or a street alone, with its
distance. Worldwide: 216 countries (`GET /streets/coverage`). `null` only outside them,
for example at sea.

One request is one billed lookup, however many layers, sets or grid codes it touches.
Metering happens before matching, so a call that matches nothing still bills.

`errors[]` is present on every response. A set that cannot be queried is skipped and
reported there with HTTP 200 — it does not fail the request.
data.summary_suggestion: Reverse geocode a coordinate to administrative boundaries and custom polygons
data.description_suggestion: Performs point-in-polygon lookup to identify administrative boundaries (country, region, municipality) and custom boundary sets containing the specified coordinate. Optionally returns the nearest street and house number worldwide (216 countries supported; returns null outside coverage areas). Returns a LookupResponse containing matched boundaries, custom polygon hits, and optional street data. One request equals one billed lookup regardless of layers or sets queried. Metering occurs before matching, so unmatched queries still incur charges. Errors array is always present; inaccessible sets are skipped and reported without failing the request.
